name: Four Points by Sheraton Batam
short_description: Four Points by Sheraton Batam is a select-service Marriott hotel in the Nagoya downtown district, offering industrial-modern rooms, an outdoor pool and free breakfast steps from Nagoya Hill Mall.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Batam is a select-service Marriott Bonvoy hotel (the former Allium Batam Hotel) set in Komplek Panorama Nagoya, the commercial heart of Batam and a short ride from the Harbour Bay ferry terminal that links to Singapore. Independent reviewers consistently describe bright, spacious, recently refreshed rooms with a clean, industrial-modern look, comfortable firm beds and a convenient location within walking distance of Nagoya Hill Mall and local food courts. Service draws frequent praise, with staff described as warm, attentive and fluent in English, and the property is regularly called good value for money. Facilities include an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness centre, a spa, an in-house bar and a restaurant serving a varied local-and-western breakfast buffet, occasionally with a made-to-order juice or sushi station. The watch-outs are consistent across sources: soundproofing is weak, with corridor noise, door-banging and street sound reaching the rooms, and several guests flag cleanliness and maintenance lapses such as marks on linen, grout mould and moss on the pool steps. Breakfast reviews are mixed, ranging from praise for variety to complaints of lukewarm dishes, and a few Marriott members note limited elite recognition and no dedicated lounge. Overall it reads as a dependable, well-located mid-tier Marriott option for a Batam getaway rather than a polished luxury stay.

faqs.question: Where is Four Points by Sheraton Batam located?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits in Komplek Panorama Nagoya, the commercial downtown of Batam, within walking distance of Nagoya Hill Mall. It is roughly a ten-minute drive from the Harbour Bay ferry terminal serving Singapore and about 20 kilometres from Hang Nadim International Airport.

faqs.question: Does the hotel include breakfast and a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rates typically include a buffet breakfast mixing local and western dishes, sometimes with a made-to-order juice or sushi station. The property also has an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness centre, a spa and an in-house bar, though reviewers note breakfast quality can vary.

faqs.question: Is Four Points by Sheraton Batam good value for a Batam stay?
faqs.answer: Reviewers consistently call it good value, praising spacious modern rooms, warm service and the central location. Watch-outs include weak soundproofing and occasional cleanliness or maintenance lapses, so it suits travellers wanting a reliable mid-tier Marriott base rather than a polished luxury resort experience.

reviews.title: Review: Four Points Hotel By Sheraton (Batam, Indonesia)
reviews.author: Dania
reviews.summary: A candid 3/5 stay: contemporary, spacious rooms and firm bedding, but marred by linen marks, grout mould, poor soundproofing, moss on the pool steps and a disorganised, smelly check-in.
